* stats_process
.param rsh__mc='agauss(100, (100)*(5)/100, 1)'
.param rsh=rsh__mc
.param vth__mc='aunif(450m, 20m)'
.param vth=vth__mc
.param tox__mc='exp(agauss(log(4n), 30m, 1))'
.param tox=tox__mc
.param cg=1p

.subckt cell a b
.param cg__mm_r='aunif(cg, (cg)*(2)/100)'
.param cg__mm=cg__mm_r
.param vth__mm_r='agauss(vth, 5m, 1)'
.param vth__mm=vth__mm_r
R1 a b 'rsh*10'
C1 b 0 'cg__mm*2'
V1 b 0 'vth__mm'
.ends cell

.subckt plain a b
R1 a b 1k
.ends plain
X1 in out cell
X2 out 0 plain
V0 in 0 1
.op
.end
